title: Swissmedic Registration Change, Otherwise Stable Source Access
summary: As of **August 21, 2026**, no major public-source change was found that should materially reduce the freshness or availability of the currently available safety databases in the application. The one notable platform change is in Switzerland: Swissmedic's swissdamed registration requirement for devices, systems, and procedure packs took effect on **July 1, 2026**, with a transition period through **December 31, 2026**. During this check, the public Swissmedic safety-notice feed remained reachable.
updates: Swissmedic introduced mandatory swissdamed registration on **July 1, 2026** and published an updated user guide on **July 7, 2026**; this is a public platform change to watch, but no immediate interruption was seen in the Swiss safety-notice feed. [Swissmedic device registration](https://www.swissmedic.ch/swissmedic/en/home/medical-devices/medizinprodukte-datenbank/produktregistrierung.html)

NMPA's English-language source remained available in the same scope as before on **August 21, 2026**; no broader public access change was found for Chinese medical-device recall pages. [NMPA English site](https://english.nmpa.gov.cn/)

No planned maintenance, portal migration, or major public access change was identified during this check for FDA MAUDE, FDA recalls, FDA Safety Communications, BfArM, MHRA, TGA, Health Canada, ANVISA, PMDA, AEMPS, or ANSM.
no_major_changes: FDA MAUDE, FDA Recall, FDA CDRH Recalls, FDA Safety Communications, BfArM, MHRA, TGA DAEN, TGA DRAC, Canada DHPR, Canada Recall, ANVISA Alerts, ANVISA Recall, PMDA, AEMPS, ANSM, NMPA English, and the public Swissmedic safety-notice feed showed no meaningful new access or availability change during this check.
